tagline.en_US: Flycast is a multi-platform Sega Dreamcast, Naomi, Naomi 2, and Atomiswave emulator derived from reicast.

description.en_US: Flycast is a multi-platform emulator derived from reicast. It emulates Sega Dreamcast, Naomi, Naomi 2, and Atomiswave arcade and console systems, allowing users to play compatible games within their environment.
